dct_title_s: Aerial Photographs. Barberton Greenbelt area, South Africa, geologic survey
dct_description_sm: Donald Lowe, Stanford Professor in Earth Sciences, Emeritus, conducted geological research in the Barberton Greenbelt area in South Africa. His work produced a comprehensive geological map of the west-central part of the Greenstone belt. Dr Lowe used a series of aerial photographs as the basis for mapping out the geological structures of the belt. This project’s objective is to digitize and georeference Dr Lowe’s annotated aerial photographs.
dct_publisher_sm: Stanford Doerr School of Sustainability. Specimen Collection
dct_spatial_sm: Barberton Greenstone Belt (Eswatini and South Africa)
